# PTSG-WPMS-Formation — Instruction Decode Map / 命令デコード表

*v0.1 · 2026-09-27 · MIT (Layer 3) · GENERATED by `hw/tools/gen_decode.py` from `hw/tools/decode_map.json` — do not edit; change the JSON and regenerate.*

*生成物。`decode_map.json` が唯一の源で、RTL のデコード表 (`wpms_decode.vh`)、アセンブラ (`pfasm_as.py`, `score_as.py`)、本書の三つがそこから作られる。手で編集しないこと。*

This is the Implementation-Arena part of the profile's encoding (master Ch.3 CL-5): *which* {mode, sub-op} exist and the source/destination ID numbers are fixed by the contract (`isa_table_w.json`, master Ch.2 §2.9); *where* the sub-op, the register ID and the immediate sit inside D8–D31 is fixed here. `gen_decode.py` checks the map against the contract before it writes anything.

契約（`isa_table_w.json`）が決めるのは {mode, sub-op} の有無と ID 番号。本表が決めるのは D8–D31 内のビット位置（実装アリーナ）。

## 1. Word layout / 語の配置

| Field | Bits | On the Core's bus | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| opcode | D0–D3 | — (the Core consumes it) | Core opcode Global |
| mode | D4–D7 | `ext_op_subopcode[3:0]` | Formation mode 1..15 (0 = Core-internal Global) |
| subop | D8–D11 | `ext_op_sub_operand[3:0]` | sub-op within the mode |
| rid | D12–D15 | `ext_op_sub_operand[7:4]` | source ID (LDA ADD SUB MUL MAC STP) or destination ID (STA) |
| imm | D16–D31 | `ext_op_data[15:0]` | immediate / literal (the Core holds the timing signals while a window runs, so D16-D31 is always an operand here) |

```
 31                    16 15    12 11     8 7      4 3      0
+-----------------------+--------+--------+--------+--------+
|   imm / literal (16)  |  rid   | sub-op |  mode  |  0000  |   Core Global, mode 1..15
+-----------------------+--------+--------+--------+--------+
```

語は Core の Global（opcode 0）で mode ≥ 1。バス上では mode = `ext_op_subopcode`、{rid, sub-op} = `ext_op_sub_operand`、即値 = `ext_op_data`。

## 2. Operand kinds / オペランドの種類

| Kind | rid (D12–D15) | imm (D16–D31) |
|---|---|---|
| none | must be 0 | must be 0 |
| src | source ID | signed 16-bit value when rid = IMM (sign-extended to 32 bits); must be 0 otherwise |
| dst | destination ID | must be 0 |
| lit9 | must be 0 | unsigned 9-bit ADRS literal in D16-D24; D25-D31 must be 0 |
| shift | must be 0 | signed 16-bit shift count: >= 0 arithmetic right, < 0 left (E8 on overflow) |

**Must be zero.** A field an instruction does not use must be 0; a non-zero value is E4 (master Ch.2 section 2.9: silence is never a semantics). The assembler never emits one.

**ゼロ必須。** 命令が使わないフィールドは 0。0 以外は E4（沈黙は意味ではない）。アセンブラはそのような語を出さない。

## 3. Instructions / 命令

| Mnemonic | mode·sub-op | Kind | Word (fields) | Example | Word |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LDA | 1·0 | src | imm · srcID · s · m · 0 | `LDA #28` | `001C0010` |
| STA | 1·1 | dst | 0000 · dstID · s · m · 0 | `STA @PPM` | `00001110` |
| ADD | 1·2 | src | imm · srcID · s · m · 0 | `ADD @PPM` | `00002210` |
| SUB | 1·3 | src | imm · srcID · s · m · 0 | `SUB TEMP` | `00001310` |
| MUL | 1·4 | src | imm · srcID · s · m · 0 | `MUL K` | `00003410` |
| MAC | 1·5 | src | imm · srcID · s · m · 0 | `MAC @PPM` | `00002510` |
| SWP | 1·6 | none | 0000 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `SWP` | `00000610` |
| SFT | 1·7 | shift | count · 0 · s · m · 0 | `SFT -4` | `FFFC0710` |
| SAD | 2·0 | lit9 | 0000000·lit9 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `SAD 0x105` | `01050020` |
| LDM | 2·1 | none | 0000 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `LDM` | `00000120` |
| STM | 2·2 | none | 0000 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `STM` | `00000220` |
| WLV | 3·1 | none | 0000 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `WLV` | `00000130` |
| WJV | 3·2 | none | 0000 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `WJV` | `00000230` |
| WSH | 3·3 | none | 0000 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `WSH` | `00000330` |
| STP | 4·0 | src | imm · srcID · s · m · 0 | `STP @PPM` | `00002040` |
| BCP | 4·1 | none | 0000 · 0 · s · m · 0 | `BCP` | `00000140` |

LDM and STM always post-increment ADRS (Map v0.3 §3). / LDM・STM は常に ADRS を後置加算する。

## 4. Rows the profile removed — E4 / 削除行（E4）

| Row | mode·sub-op | Why | Word on the bus decodes to |
|---|---|---|---|
| RTW | 2·3 | W-F25 | E4 |
| CMT | 2·4 | W-F25 | E4 |
| PSH | 2·5 | W-T1 | E4 |
| POP | 2·6 | W-T1 | E4 |
| WSV | 3·0 | W-F28 / W-R12 | E4 |

Every {mode, sub-op} not in §3 decodes to E4 as well: unassigned sub-ops of modes 1–4, and modes 5–15. The hardware checks this (`wpms_decode.vh`); the validator (`pfasm_tools_w.py`) checks the removed mnemonics.

§3 にない {mode, sub-op} はすべて E4（モード 1–4 の未割当サブオペ、モード 5–15）。

## 5. Source and destination IDs / ソース・デスティネーション ID

| Source | ID | | Destination | ID |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IMM | 0 | | TEMP | 0 |
| TEMP | 1 | | STORE | 1 |
| PPM | 2 | |  |  |
| K | 3 | |  |  |
| I | 4 | |  |  |
| SN | 5 | |  |  |
| SSS | 6 | |  |  |

Reserved → E4. Sources: 7 (reserved), 8-B (R0-R3, unimplemented), C-F (reserved). Destinations: 2-5 (R0-R3, unimplemented), 6 (ADRS, removed by W-F1), 7-F (reserved).

予約 ID は E4。ID の番号は契約（マスター第2章 §2.9）が規範、ビット位置のみ本表。

## 6. Error codes (`error_code[4:0]`) / エラーコード

| Row | Code | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| E4 | 4 (0x04) | reserved or removed {mode, sub-op}, reserved source/destination ID, or a non-zero must-be-zero field |
| E5 | 5 (0x05) | ADRS outside the map of Map v0.3 section 4 (0x11B-0x1FF) at LDM, STM or an @PPM operand |
| E8 | 8 (0x08) | MUL, MAC or SFT (left) result outside signed 32 bits (SFT as the golden model: SD-13) |
| EW2 | 18 (0x12) | prefetch of a block with N outside [N_MIN, NMAX] |
| EW3 | 19 (0x13) | write into a read-only region (inbox view, COMMIT view, sweep words, status) |
| EW4 | 20 (0x14) | write-window violation: store written outside HK, CUR written outside a packet window, BCP outside HK |
| EW5 | 21 (0x15) | invalid sweep word at BCP (P > 8, repeated block, sum N > NMAX) or sum N of the sweep in effect > NMAX |
| EW6 | 22 (0x16) | STP with Temp < 0 |

Bit 4 marks the profile's own rows (EW*). E1/E2 are validator-only: the Core's bus carries no band (SD-01, SD-02). / ビット4はプロファイル固有行（EW*）。E1/E2 は検証器のみ（バスに帯域がない：SD-01, SD-02）。

## 7. Timing-signal bits of the score / 楽譜のタイミング信号ビット

| Name | Bits | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| TS_PKT | timing_signals[0] | packet Stay |
| TS_CSEL | timing_signals[2:1] | Condition lane select, 0 STROBE, 1 NONEMPTY, 2 MORE, 3 reserved (W-R16) |
| (free) | timing_signals[15:3] | — |

`score_as.py` writes them (`PKT`, `CSEL=STROBE|NONEMPTY|MORE`) into D16–D31 of Stay Set and Stay words (Deliverable 2; Deliverable 3 §4). / `score_as.py` が Stay Set と Stay の D16–D31 に書く。

## 8. Assembler operands / アセンブラのオペランド

| Operand | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `#<n>` | IMM source, -32768..32767 |
| `@PPM` | PPM source (reads the L2 space at ADRS) / STORE destination (writes the L2 space at ADRS) |
| `TEMP` | TEMP source or destination |
| `K` | source 3 |
| `I` | source 4 |
| `SN` | source 5 |
| `SSS` | source 6 |
